clips.name: Newcastle upon Tyne (Wrn4_uCxRCQ)
clips.title: Newcastle Driving - Tyne Bridge, Central Motorway, Jesmond and Coast Road
clips.note: Newcastle upon Tyne, UK — Tyne Bridge, Central Motorway, Jesmond, Coast Road. The first non-US clip in this fleet and the first with a SINGLE-DIGIT degree longitude (W1d), which no US clip exercises — every other stamp here sits at 83-111 degrees west. Also a fifth camera family (Nextbase), and its clock reads 14/01/2000, a reminder that the stamp's DATE is not to be trusted even where its position is.
